findings.headline: A commercial condition — a no-refund policy — appears only away from your pricing page
findings.explanation: Terms of Service sets out a no-refund policy, but nothing equivalent appears on your pricing page. Conditions that change what a customer actually pays or receives belong where the buying decision is made; discovering them later is where churn and chargebacks start.
findings.claim_b: Terms of Service: a no-refund policy

evidence_a.quote: (no equivalent statement found on the pricing page)

findings.caveat: Detected by absence, so a condition stated in an image, a tooltip or a collapsed accordion on the pricing page would be missed.
